text:
```artifact
@startuml
actor Patient
actor Chemist
actor Lab
actor Admin
participant System

== Prescription Reception ==
Patient -> System: Submit Prescription
System -> Chemist: Notify Prescription Received
System -> Lab: Notify Prescription Received

== Chemist Offline Delivery ==
Chemist -> System: Request Medicines
System -> Chemist: Provide Medicines
Chemist -> Patient: Deliver Medicines Offline

== Lab Specimen Collection and Report Delivery ==
Lab -> System: Request Specimen Collection
System -> Patient: Notify Specimen Collection
Patient -> Lab: Provide Specimen
Lab -> System: Submit Lab Report
System -> Patient: Notify Lab Report Available

== Admin Speciality and Doctor Database ==
Admin -> System: Populate Speciality Database
Admin -> System: Link Specialities to Doctors
Admin -> System: Populate Doctor Database

== Patient Registration ==
Patient -> System: Register
System -> Patient: Confirm Registration

== Error Handling ==
alt Prescription Not Found
    System -> Patient: Notify Prescription Not Found
else Medicines Not Available
    Chemist -> Patient: Notify Medicines Not Available
else Specimen Collection Failed
    Lab -> Patient: Notify Specimen Collection Failed
else Lab Report Not Generated
    Lab -> Patient: Notify Lab Report Not Generated
end

@enduml
```
